"""Compile only the analyst probe against already-built published-805 classes; no Gradle."""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root = Path('/workspace/scratch/35343fa96783')
out = root / 'single-wet-crop-probe'
cache = root / 'gradle-home-current/caches/modules-2/files-2.1'
classes = root / 'Experiment-2-preview-performance/app/build/tmp/kotlin-classes/debug'
repo = root / 'Experiment-2-preview-performance'
revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=repo, text=True).strip()
assert revision == '8050121a7a6e3a1d52854d3c398ad1d29a33bcfe'
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--exit-code', 'HEAD', '--', 'app/src/main'], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True)


def jar(group, module, version):
    found = list((cache / group / module / version).glob('*/' + module + '-' + version + '.jar'))
    assert len(found) == 1, (group, module, version, found)
    return found[0]


stdlib = jar('org.jetbrains.kotlin', 'kotlin-stdlib', '2.0.21')
compiler = [jar('org.jetbrains.kotlin', 'kotlin-compiler-embeddable', '2.0.21'), stdlib,
            jar('org.jetbrains.intellij.deps', 'trove4j', '1.0.20200330'),
            jar('org.jetbrains', 'annotations', '13.0'),
            jar('org.jetbrains.kotlinx', 'kotlinx-coroutines-core-jvm', '1.6.4')]
runtime = [classes, stdlib,
           jar('org.jetbrains.kotlinx', 'kotlinx-serialization-core-jvm', '1.7.3'),
           jar('org.jetbrains.kotlinx', 'kotlinx-serialization-json-jvm', '1.7.3'),
           jar('org.jetbrains.kotlinx', 'kotlinx-coroutines-core-jvm', '1.10.2'),
           jar('org.jetbrains.kotlinx', 'kotlinx-coroutines-test-jvm', '1.10.2'),
           jar('org.mockito', 'mockito-core', '5.7.0'),
           jar('net.bytebuddy', 'byte-buddy', '1.14.9'),
           jar('net.bytebuddy', 'byte-buddy-agent', '1.14.9'),
           jar('org.objenesis', 'objenesis', '3.3'),
           jar('junit', 'junit', '4.13.2')]
transforms = root / 'gradle-home-current/caches/8.14.3/transforms'
runtime += sorted(transforms.glob('*/transformed/android.jar'))
runtime += sorted(transforms.glob('*/transformed/*/jars/classes.jar'))
runtime += sorted(transforms.glob('*/transformed/*-runtime.jar'))
java = root / 'jdk17/bin/java'
probe = out / 'classes'
probe.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
command = [str(java), '-cp', ':'.join(map(str, compiler)), 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.cli.jvm.K2JVMCompiler',
           '-no-stdlib', '-no-reflect', '-jvm-target', '17', '-cp', ':'.join(map(str, runtime)),
           '-d', str(probe), str(out / 'SingleWetCropProbe.kt')]
result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr
result = subprocess.run([str(java), '-javaagent:' + str(jar('net.bytebuddy', 'byte-buddy-agent', '1.14.9')),
                         '-cp', ':'.join(map(str, [probe] + runtime)), 'SingleWetCropProbeKt'],
                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
report = ['No Gradle; probe compiled against existing published-805 production classes.']
report.append('Source revision=' + revision + '; app/src/main unchanged from HEAD')
for name in ['data/repository/canvas/CanvasRepositoryImpl', 'core/render/StrokeRasterizer', 'core/render/WetBrushPickup']:
    path = classes / ('com/artflow/studio/' + name + '.class')
    report.append(name + '.class SHA256=' + hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
report += [result.stdout, result.stderr, 'Exit=' + str(result.returncode)]
(out / 'results.txt').write_text('\n'.join(report))
print('\n'.join(report))
assert result.returncode == 0
